## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Sòng-period Esoteric *dhāraṇī* scripture translated by **Fǎtiān** ([法天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%A4%A9)). Companion to [KR6j0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0089) (Xuánzàng's *Zhū fó xīn tuóluóní jīng* T918) — the title's *xīnyìn* 心印 ("heart-seal") expands the earlier "heart-dhāraṇī" with the additional *yìn* (seal / *mudrā*) component.

**Abstract**

The text is the Sòng-period parallel to T918, presenting a related but distinct *dhāraṇī* scripture in the same conceptual family. The translation dates from Fǎtiān's career at the Sòng Yìjīngyuàn (980–1001).
